items.title: Dan and Diane Riccio Make $3 Million Commitment To The Script U Scholarship Society To Support UMass Football
items.summary: Daniel J. Riccio Jr. '86, '24MS and his wife, Diane M. (Casey) Riccio, Ph.D., have committed $3 million to the Script U Scholarship Society to support the University of Massachusetts Football program.

items.title: In Memoriam: Phil Vandersea
items.summary: The University of Massachusetts athletics department mourns the passing of UMass Athletics Hall of Famer Phil Vandersea, one of the most versatile and accomplished players in program history.

items.title: UMass football freefall continues at UConn
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, Conn.  – The Massachusetts football team stacked up four wins to start the season like dominoes. Since then, those dominoes have fallen one by one, with the momentum of each loss falling into the next game. items.title: UMass offense falls flat in loss to UConn
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, Conn.— The Massachusetts football team traveled to Rentschler Field on Friday night, yet seemed to leave its offensive spark in Amherst, Mass., falling 35-16 to UConn. The Minutemen (4-4, 1-3 Mid-American Conference) offense failed to convert on crucial third downs and racked up penalty after penalty, giving the Huskies (4-3) more than enough...

items.title: Football At UConn On Friday Night
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, Conn. – University of Massachusetts football fell, 35-16, to Connecticut on Friday night at Pratt & Whitney Stadium at Rentschler Field (32,106).

items.title: UMass Athletics And Greenfield Savings Bank Announce Three-Year Sponsorship
items.summary: University of Massachusetts Athletics has launched a multi-faceted partnership with Greenfield Savings Bank, supporting the football, basketball and hockey teams with a three-year sponsorship in a collaboration that will extend through 2028.

items.title: Massachusetts Football Drops 25-18 Contest At Buffalo In Overtime
items.summary: BUFFALO, N.Y. – The University of Massachusetts football team dropped a 25-18 decision in overtime to Buffalo in the Flagship Cup presented by Milton Cat on Saturday afternoon at Broadview Stadium (6,037).

items.title: Morris and Musa Selected as UMass Student-Athletes of the Week
items.summary: Two student-athletes earned this week's UMass Student-Athletes of the Week, presented by UMassFive College Credit Union. Derek Morris for football and Jack Musa for hockey were both recognized.

items.title: UMass Football Comeback Falls Short to Miami (OH), 20-19
items.summary: The University of Massachusetts football team fought back from a 20-10 deficit with five minutes left in the fourth quarter, but a two-point conversion attempt to win was no good as Miami (OH) escaped, 20-19, on Saturday.
